title_en: Intermediate English - 6 - Have you ever taken a road trip before?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Preah. I'm from Belize. I am an ESL teacher. My question was, have you ever taken a road trip before?

I have taken many road trips before, and actually two weeks ago, on the 7th of October, my family and I, we took an eight-hour road trip to Cancun, Mexico. We stopped at a lot of shabby gas stations. We met a lot of amazing and friendly people. Even at the border, we ate some delicious Mexican tacos and tortas, and we had an amazing time in Cancun as well. On our way back. We were actually blocked on the road by two animals: an alligator and a tapir, which is my country's national animal. So, it was very fascinating to see that in Cancun. There was a lot of sightseeing to do. We saw different amusement parks on the way. We stopped in Tulum, Playa del Carmen, as well as Bacalar. All in all, I do hope my family ... (the video cuts off)

title_en: Intermediate English - 7 - Who do you speak English with?
paras_en: Hi. I'm Ozlem and I'm from Turkey. Here is my question: Who do you speak English with?

I work as an ESL teacher in a private school here in Turkey. At school, as a general rule, we do not speak our native language because we believe our students should be surrounded by the second language they learn, which is English in our case. So, we try to speak English everywhere anytime we are with them. In the process of language learning, there are four skills students should acquire: Reading, writing, listening, and speaking, and speaking is the productive skill. This means if students, if they need to improve this skill, they need to produce.

Anyway, apart from that, I have many other colleagues and native friends, so we always speak English together. But if you do not have people around you speaking English, you can also find friends online or you can have an English tutor to practice online. That's it. Thank you and see you. Bye.

title_en: Intermediate English - 8 - What is something you loved to do as a child?
paras_en: Hi. My name's Rachel and I'm from Australia, and my question is, what is something you loved to do as a child?

When I was a child I grew up near a gorge. A gorge is kind of like a forest. So I would go for walks. I would ride bikes. I was a very active child. We didn't have phones the way we have phones now, which I'm grateful for. I loved it. I sound old saying that, but yeah, I would play outside, water bombing, playing games with my friends, looking at nature, kangaroos. Where I grew up we had a lot of animals, so it was just exploring and it was a lot of fun.

title_en: Intermediate English - 9 - Did you have a part-time job when you were younger?
paras_en: The question that I'm answering is did you have a part-time job when you were younger?

The answer to this is I've had a few part-time jobs, but I'll talk about my first part-time job, which is delivering the newspaper. So, in 1994, when I was still in high school, every Wednesday, I would take a whole stack of newspapers in a trolley and go around the neighborhood and put all these newspapers into people's letter box. Now, it's the local paper, and unfortunately now, the local paper doesn't exist anymore, but I do have those memories when I had to walk around in the rain, had to walk around in the hail, had to walk around in the sunshine on those hot 30 degree days to deliver these newspapers after school without fail.
So, that is my first part-time job.

title_en: Intermediate English - 10 - What do you usually eat for dinner?
paras_en: What do I usually eat for dinner?

Okay, so every day is different. There isn't that one kind of food that I usually eat or that one dish that I always eat. No, every day is different. Sometimes I eat fish soup. Sometimes I eat vegetable soup, sometimes noodles, sometimes spaghetti. So every day is different. But if you ask me what do I love to eat or what do I prefer, I would say cheese and chicken. Oh my God! Anything that has cheese and chicken in it, I would die for it. Although I'm trying to be vegan. I want to be vegan, but I can't. I love chicken a lot. Oh my God! Anything that has chicken and cheese in it, I would die for it.

title_en: What do you think is the most difficult language to learn?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Preah. The question I was asked was, what do you think is the most difficult language to learn?

And as you probably know, English is the most difficult to learn, and that is coming from an English teacher. Okay, now, why do I say this? I know how to speak four languages: English, Spanish, Creole, which is my native language, my country's native language, patois is English, patois, as well as American, I'm just kidding. American isn't a language. But yeah, I know how to speak English, Spanish, and what we call Creole. But why do I say English? It's because there's a lot of terms. There's a lot of different tenses. There's a lot of words that mean one thing, but it's pronounced a different way. There's a lot of letters that are silent in words. There's a lot of different pronunciations for letters, and it's also very different than what other countries or other languages are used to.
So that is why I would say English is the most difficult.

title_en: Intermediate English - 12 - Do you have a pet?
paras_en: Hello, this is Antti, and this is for elllo.org. And my question today is, do you have a pet?

And my answer is, yes, I do have a pet. I have a dog. My dog is white, and my dog is called Siri. And my dog is a miniature schnauzer, a small dog. I love my dog very much, and I know that she loves me, as well. So, I go for a walk with my dog almost every day. My dog likes to eat meat and also the same food I eat.
Okay, so can you tell me about your dog or your pet? Bye-bye!
Hello, my name is Juan Cruz. I'm from Argentina. And my question is, what is your favorite meal?

Well, so my favorite meal is typical here in Argentina. It's called empanadas, and my favorite type of empanadas are meat empanadas. So my family owned a pizza shop when I was little, and I would have them all the time. So, when I have them now, it's like going back to when I was a kid. So it consists of making a filling, which has meat in it, and you put that in a dough. The dough can then go fried or in the oven, which is my preference for about, I think, half an hour, 45 minutes. And then when you eat it, you can add a little bit of sugar to it to have a salty and sugary taste in it.
And I absolutely love them.

title_en: What is a company you admire?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Rachel, and I am from Australia. So my question is what is a company you admire?

A company I admire, I believe it's Beyond Blue. They help with mental health issues and they support different people from around the world if they are struggling. Another company I admire is I think it's WW something. It's to do with wildlife. They help animals. They do a lot of environmental work. And in general, any company that really helps a person, a place, is a company that I support and that I think is really great.

title_en: Intermediate English - 15 - Have you ever tried a fat diet?
paras_en: Have I ever had a fad diet?
No, I have never had any type of diet. Okay. Why haven't I had a fad diet?

First, it's because it is a trendy weight loss plan, and I don't usually follow trends. Second, it's because I think I'm already fit in my body. I don't think that I need to be losing weight. I don't think that I need to be following any type of diet for the moment. Okay. Maybe in the future if I ever gain weight, I would do it, although I don't think so because I don't like these things. That diet is a very, very severe diet. I don't like these things. Am I against it, though? No. Everybody's free to do whatever they want with their body. I'm nobody to judge, but for me, I don't think I would ever do it even if I gained weight, but maybe one day, I don't know.
Who knows? So, yeah, that's it.

title_en: Who is my favorite historical figure?
paras_en: So, hi everybody. This is Antti from Finland and this is for elllo.org. My question today is who is my favorite historical figure?

And my favorite historical figure is Abraham Lincoln, the former president of United States. He was the president in the 1860s, and the reason why I think President Lincoln is my favorite historical figure is that he freed the slaves and he especially freed the black people in America. And he was a forefather for everybody who wants to have equality and civil rights and freedom for everybody.
Okay, so is your favorite historical figure. Please do tell.

title_en: How do you feel about having a pet?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Ozlem, and I'm from Turkey. Here is my question: How do you feel about having a pet?

Having a pet brings a circle of love into our lives. This is certain, and I remember reading an article about human and animal connection, and in that article, there were around ten health benefits, like lower depression, blood rates, more physical activity, and so on. Yes, they are definitely good for humans.

And actually, I have a pet, and we took him when he was a puppy, and he really brought lots of love to our lives, lots of joy to our lives. We all love him very much, and we try to spend time with him. But on the contrary, I sometimes feel guilty about him because I cannot spend so much time with him, so that makes me sad.
Yes, as a result, having a pet is definitely good for humans. But the question is, are we good for them?
Thank you. See you.
